facts.fact: The Bank of Namibia's 2025 annual report, as reported by The Namibian, says Namibia is represented in SADC-RTGS by five banks including the central bank.
The Bank of Namibia says Namibian banks processed R708 billion, 25% of the R2.8 trillion total, through SADC-RTGS in 2025, and R76.33 billion in December 2025 per the South African Reserve Bank.

systems.owner: South African Reserve Bank for SADC central banks
